keyPhrases.text: Michael Urie establishes himself as a fearless and compelling leading man
delivering a master-class in physical comedy and dramatic authenticity
Some of those cuts (like Arnold's meatier monologues) are missed
Torch Song's flame still burns bright
Fierstein's words are as poignant now as they were then
supported by a strong supporting cast
That's when Torch Song really seems to catch fire
impossible not to feel that same electricity in the theater

reasoning: Enthusiastic praise throughout with superlatives like 'exquisite,' 'master-class,' and 'undeniable charisma.' Only minor criticism about some cuts being missed. Strong recommendation evident from the glowing language about performances and production.
